files.description: One-page PDF describing EHI export file formats: JSON for single patient (USCDI v1 + other applicable data) and .bak (SQL Server database backup) for patient population export. This is the entirety of the vendor's EHI export format documentation.
Screenshot of the top of the ONC certification disclosure page showing certification details (developer name, product name, version, contact info, certification number).
Screenshot of the EHI Export section on the disclosure page showing the two export types (single patient and population), variability disclaimer, File Formats button, and FHIR Endpoints links.

Screenshot of the FHIR API documentation page at fhir.10e11.com showing the getting started section, terms of use, and client registration guidance. This is the (g)(10) API documentation, not (b)(10) EHI export documentation.
